query:
UPDATE attachments
         SET state = 'ready',
             kind = $2,
             content_type = $3,
             filename = $4,
             storage_id = $5,
             width = $6,
             height = $7,
             duration_ms = $8,
             animated = $9,
             waveform = $10,
             has_thumbnail = $11,
             thumbnail_width = $12,
             thumbnail_height = $13,
             updated_at = $14
         WHERE id = $1
